description: This file defines the PimDefinedReportModel class, which is a PHP model class used within the OrangeHRM project to represent a report entity with serialization capabilities. It implements the Normalizable interface, uses traits for serialization, and constructs the model with data from a Report entity.

classes.name: PimDefinedReportModel
classes.description: A model class representing a report, used for serialization and API responses within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a Report entity, setting entity data, filters, and attribute names for serialization.
